components.css: .ds-rory{max-width:36rem;font-family: ui-rounded, 'SF Pro Rounded', system-ui, sans-serif;} .ds-name{font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:600;color:oklch(0.47 0.02 255);letter-spacing:0.02em;margin-bottom:0.3rem} .ds-reply{background:oklch(0.995 0.003 250);color:oklch(0.24 0.02 255);border:1px solid oklch(0.89 0.01 250);padding:0.65rem 0.95rem;border-radius:4px 14px 14px 14px;line-height:1.55} .ds-meta{font-size:0.75rem;color:oklch(0.47 0.02 255);margin-top:0.2rem} .ds-meta span{margin-left:0.6rem}

components.description: Example phrase or one-tap next step.
components.css: .ds-chip{font-family: ui-rounded, 'SF Pro Rounded', system-ui, sans-serif;border:1px solid oklch(0.62 0.02 255);background:oklch(0.995 0.003 250);color:oklch(0.24 0.02 255);border-radius:999px;padding:0.5rem 0.95rem;min-height:2.5rem;font-size:0.9375rem;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,background-color .15s,transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-chip:hover{border-color:oklch(0.5 0.12 195);background:oklch(0.94 0.03 195)} .ds-chip:active{transform:scale(.97)} .ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid oklch(0.5 0.12 195);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview: A fast, honest service desk. You ask, Rory answers, and nothing is performed in between. The interface is a single column on a cool paper-tinted ground: your messages are solid teal, Rory's answers are plain white sheets with a hairline border. The system is deliberately plain because Rory is not an AI and must never look like one.
keyCharacteristics: Flat at rest: hairline borders and tonal layers, no shadows.
One accent (Signal Teal) that always means "you" or "act".
Rounded system face, small type steps, generous line height for reading replies.
Pill-shaped controls, 14px message bubbles with a 4px "tail" corner.
Light and dark follow the system setting; both are first-class.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal means "you" or "do something". Reply content, labels and chrome never use it, with one exception: links inside replies.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Neutrals carry a hint of the cool hue. Never pure gray, never pure white or black.

rules.name: The Weight Over Size Rule
rules.body: The header title is only 1.05x the body; weight carries the difference. Do not enlarge chrome text to add hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow on bubbles, chips, lists or buttons. Separate a surface with a border or a tonal step, never both a border and a soft shadow.

dos: Do keep Signal Teal for the user's own messages, the send button, the avatar, focus and links only.
Do separate surfaces with one Hairline border or one tonal step, and give controls the stronger Control Edge.
Do keep every tap target at least 36px tall, and 44px on touch screens, and show a 2px Signal Teal focus ring on :focus-visible.
Do show which tool produced an answer and give honest, specific example phrases.
donts: Don't use shadows, glows or glass on bubbles, chips or lists.
Don't tint Rory's replies teal or add gradients, colored side borders or decorative icons.
Don't write copy that implies open-ended AI ("ask anything"); name real capabilities.
Don't use emoji as interface icons (emoji belong to reply content only); draw icons as SVG.
Don't overlay the typeahead on the conversation.
